title: Type Rush
description: Type random words as fast as possible to stay alive! ⌨️ Keep up with the words or your 'health' will drop.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. Words will appear on the screen one by one.
3. Type each word correctly and press Enter to submit.
4. Each correct word increases your score and keeps your health up.
5. Missing or mistyping a word decreases your health.
6. Survive as long as possible and try to beat your high score!

Tips:
- Focus and type accurately.
- Faster typing increases survival and score.
- Keep an eye on your health bar.
- Have fun and challenge yourself! 🚀
author: G0ldNe0
